chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Isa ibn Abdullah from his father from his grandfather from his forefathers. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Whoever recites 'Say: He is Allah, the One' (Surah al-Ikhlas) when he goes to bed, Allah the Mighty and Majestic will forgive fifty years of his sins.

key_terms.ذنوب: Sins, transgressions -- acts of disobedience to Allah
key_terms.قل هو الله أحد: Surah al-Ikhlas (Quran 112) -- 'Say: He is Allah, the One,' the surah of divine unity
key_terms.مضجع: Place of sleep, bed -- the place where one lies down to rest

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah al-Ikhlas before going to bed according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) encouraged the recitation of Surah al-Ikhlas (Quran 112, 'Say: He is Allah, the One') before sleeping, promising that Allah will forgive fifty years of sins for the one who does so. This highlights the immense spiritual merit Islam attaches to the recitation of this short but theologically central surah, which encapsulates the doctrine of divine unity (tawhid).
